changelog:
Initial release: Build and execute a complete content marketing strategy for solopreneurs.

- Provides an actionable step-by-step playbook for content planning, production, and measurement
- Covers audience research, content pillars, format and channel selection, and content calendar design
- Includes distribution strategies, repurposing workflows, and best-practice cadences
- Offers templates and tables for content ideas, calendar, and performance metrics
- Designed for simplicity and high ROI, tailored to solo business owners and consultants
summary: Build and execute a content marketing strategy for a solopreneur business. Use when planning what content to create, deciding on content formats and channels...
